payload.rationale: Frozen next-day NBS forecast is 78°F and model XND is 3°F. A declared Gaussian distribution with mean 78 and SD sqrt(3^2+1^2) incorporates a subjective independent 1°F settlement/provider allowance. Integrate over [75.5,77.5) for integer 76–77°F. This is model-based, not empirical calibration.
assumptions: Gaussian error with zero bias initially
Model XND can serve as an initial spread proxy
Independent 1°F provider/window SD, selected before historical data
uncertainties: Local next-day forecast bias and dispersion
Current synoptic conditions and alternative NWS forecast
